rust_summary: holder sets over the game's own registries (`native_holder_set`): a tag's members, every entry of a registry.
doc_summary: `native_holder_set(registry, set)` gives the entries a holder set names in one of the game's registries (`block`, `item`, `fluid`, `entity_type`...), in order: an id, `#tag` (the loaded tag's members), a list of them, or NeoForge's `any`, `or`, `and` and `not` objects. A mod lists a block tag's blocks or every item of the game with it; `None` for what the game keeps no list of. Bundles need "hooks": @API:holder_sets@.
